• 10min easy spin, building 55-65% FTP.

• 3 sets of 3x [2min @85-89% FTP (low cadence) + 1min @85-89% FTP (high cadence)], with 5min easy spin @50-60% FTP between sets.

FUEL:
Target 59g carbs/hr. Practice this prescription.
MAIN SET:
- 15min @ 65% FTP (Z2, RPE 3)
- 2 x (4x2:50 @ 83% FTP (Z3, RPE 5-6), 0:10 recovery @ 165% FTP (Z5+, RPE 8-9) + 40min @ 66% FTP (Z2, RPE 3))
- 4x2:50 @ 83% FTP (Z3, RPE 5-6), 0:10 recovery @ 165% FTP (Z5+, RPE 8-9)
- 15min @ 66% FTP (Z2, RPE 3)
- 4x2:50 @ 83% FTP (Z3, RPE 5-6), 0:10 recovery @ 165% FTP (Z5+, RPE 8-9)
- 22min @ 66% FTP (Z2, RPE 3)
- 10min @ 50% FTP (Z1, RPE 3)

RACE SIMULATION — ACT 1 OF 1

THE UNIT: 4x[2:50 @76-90% (tempo rhythm) + 0:10 @150-180% (micro-surge)] — this is the crux demand of the race: hold tempo and answer sudden surges — no supplied climbing profile to shape this any other way.

THE SHAPE: 4 units across 1.9hr of Z2 — Act 1 of 1. Each act packs them tighter; I've built it so race day is the only day you do the full count.

AUDIBLE: if the legs are gone after unit 3, skip the remaining surges and ride the tempo blocks

sessions.title: Day Off — Race Prep

sessions.description:
RACE DAY: TBD — Oct 24 event slot
Date: 2026-10-24

FUELING PLAN:
- Carbs/hour: 59g (range: [52, 66])
- Total carbs: 492g over race
- Start fueling at 20 min, every 20-30 min thereafter
- Pre-race: 100-150g carbs 3-4 hours before start

PACING STRATEGY:
- Ceiling rule: I want the effort you can repeat all day on every climb. If breathing stops being controlled, back off before the crest.
- First third: deliberately conservative (RPE 4-5). Let the day come to you; fuel on the timer and do not answer early surges.
- Middle third: settle into sustainable RPE 5-6, protect smooth cadence, and keep eating before hunger appears.
- Final third: hold form, keep eating, and make only measured decisions that preserve a strong finish.
- Technical sections: Smooth > Fast. Avoid mechanicals.

HYDRATION:
- Drink to thirst — 500-750 ml/hr is a starting estimate to adjust for heat and sweat rate, not a quota. 500-1000 mg sodium per hour. Do not force fluid beyond thirst; you should finish a shade lighter than you started, never heavier.
